title: CoToan: Executable Rules and a Representation Contract for Reproducible Game AI Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2610.39353v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Game AI results are comparable only when different implementations expose the same decision problem. Yet seemingly minor representation choices can silently change that problem by altering action probabilities or collapsing states with different outcomes. We study this issue through CoToan, an executable specification and representation contract for Vietnamese Mathematical Chess connecting the Game Description Language (GDL) with OpenSpiel. The game provides a useful case because a single capture may have multiple arithmetic justifications, while outcomes can depend on scoring rules and a finite playing horizon. CoToan therefore represents actions by their state transitions rather than by arithmetic witnesses, and treats time and victory configuration as part of task identity. translated_title: CoToan：面向可复现游戏AI评估的可执行规则与表示契约
translated_abstract: 只有当不同的实现向智能体呈现相同的决策问题时，游戏AI的结果才具有可比性。然而，看似微小的表示选择可能会通过改变动作概率或合并具有不同结果的初始状态，从而悄然改变该决策问题。我们通过CoToan来研究这一问题。CoToan是一个针对越南数学象棋的可执行规范与表示契约，将游戏描述语言（GDL）与OpenSpiel连接起来。该游戏是一个很有价值的研究案例，因为单次吃子可能存在多种算术上的合理依据，而胜负结果又可能取决于计分规则和有限的比赛回合数。因此，CoToan以动作的状态转移而非算术证明来表示动作，并将时间和胜利配置视为任务身份的一部分。跨表示测试表明，在数百个采样与构造的棋局局面中，两种表示在合法动作、后继状态和终止结果上均保持一致……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出CoToan——一个连接GDL与OpenSpiel的越南数学象棋可执行规范与表示契约，通过以状态转移而非算术依据来表示动作、并将时间与胜利配置纳入任务身份，解决了不同实现间表示选择悄然改变决策问题、导致游戏AI结果不可比的问题。
en_tdlr: CoToan is an executable specification and representation contract for Vietnamese Mathematical Chess linking GDL with OpenSpiel, which represents actions by their state transitions rather than arithmetic witnesses and treats time and victory configuration as part of task identity, thereby preventing subtle representation choices from silently altering the decision problem and enabling reproducible game AI evaluation.
